note: Design constants (D15), not text data. Font units of the font (1000 per em). line_width: a full text line (about the p90 of DigitalKhatt Madina's natural widths on 1441H lines). page_scale_floor: smallest per-page font scale, per mille. line_pitch and margins: for the owner to judge at GATE G1. overline_marks, overline_thickness, overline_clearance (D18): KFGQPC's U+06E4 is the sajdah overline (KFGQPC's font draws it as a bar over the word; the 1441H print overlines exactly these 26 words); thickness and gap measured on the print's word glyphs (quran-qcf4, qcf4-npm-1.1.0): bar 101-124 of 2500 units thick, 120-955 above the word's ink, one height per line.
